versions.changelog: SEO/AEO/GEO-optimized docs: richer features, FAQ, comparison table, geo/local section, accurate CLI quick-start; README badges. No code changes.

Major update with expanded features and new commands:

- Adds support for multiple diagram types: flowchart, sequence, architecture, and Gantt charts.
- Produces valid Excalidraw JSON compatible with excalidraw.com.
- Introduces colored elements and text labels.
- Provides new commands for diagram creation, rendering, exporting, listing templates, and self-testing.
- Implements zero external dependencies; Python standard library only.
- Includes CI integration scripts and improved documentation.

Initial release of excalidraw-cli.

- Generate Excalidraw hand-drawn style diagrams (architecture, flow, sequence) as JSON files via CLI.
- Edit and merge existing Excalidraw diagrams from the terminal.
- Support for exporting diagrams to PNG or SVG formats.
- No installation required—just download and run with Python 3.8+.
- Includes commands to inspect diagram files and merge multiple diagrams.
